question: Which drugs have the most side effects in the database?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN d.name, count(se) AS se_count ORDER BY se_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Compare the side effect profiles of Acetylsalicylic acid and Warfarin — what effects are shared?
cypher: MATCH (d1:Drug {name: 'Acetylsalicylic acid'})-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect)<-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]-(d2:Drug {name: 'Warfarin'}) RETURN se.name ORDER BY se.name LIMIT 10

question: Which drugs have Dizziness as a side effect?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect {name: 'Dizziness'}) RETURN d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 10

question: For drugs targeting PTGS1, what are their most common side effects?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene {gene_name: 'PTGS1'}) MATCH (d)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN se.name, count(d) AS drug_count ORDER BY drug_count DESC LIMIT 10
